_comment: The diplomacy audience (wire ids 57 player, 58 AI; open fixes 46 and 47), work order 185 part 10. Geometry is screens/audience/augeom.py (transcribed from dip_scrn_main.cpp and fields.cpp); every word on the screen is the engine's, carried by open fix 47's DIPL block; the stage is DIPLOMAT.LBX's own art. The marks name every difference, each held by the audience smoke group and named in v3_projektstatus.md.

marks.deviation_hud_frameless: HUD panels behind the statement and the menu, where the original prints on the room.
marks.omission_talking_loop: The ambassador's animation is not drawn: its phase is not on the wire. The still is the frame the original shows with animations off.
marks.omission_header_line: JIMTEXT2's header line at (320, 10) — 'Player n: name' or 'race Ambassador' — needs an extraction this order does not add.
marks.omission_audience_help: The right click's help in the audience is not built (help.json has no regions).
marks.unverified_fix46: The ids 57 / 58 come from open fix 46 (NOT APPLIED); without it the audience runs under its caller's id and never reaches this screen.
marks.unverified_fix47: The screen draws only from open fix 47's DIPL block (NOT APPLIED): built against blocks recorded off a scratch engine, live on no applied engine. Without it the screen claims nothing.
marks.omission_glass_remap: The ambassador's glassed pixels are drawn as their palette indices, a hatching; the original remaps them against what lies beneath (Update_Glass_Remap_Colors_, dip_scrn_main.cpp:476) — translucency HD does not reproduce.
